Title: New Application for Registering for an USI course

If you want to register for a course at the sports institute, you need to select a course.
If slots are free, the system tells you the courses, and dates.
Select one.
Next, you need to check if you already have an account at the sports institute.
If not, you need to check whether you are registered at an eligible university.
If you are, register your account.
If you are not, request an activation and wait for a response.
As soon as you have an account, log into it.
The application is also connected to your twitter account, and lets you tweet to friends who might want to join you, you can complete the registration for the course and provide the payment information.
In the end, you will receive a course ticket.

result.rule: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.

Give every process and every expanded subProcess its own explicit start event and end event. A trigger that occurs after the main flow (for example later feedback or a return) is joined to the main flow by a gateway, or modeled as an event subprocess or a separate process.
An ordinary embedded subprocess participates in normal sequence flow and may contain its own starts, ends, activities, gateways and flows.
Use a parallel split when all outgoing branches start. Do not add decision conditions to parallel branches.
Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
Use a parallel join when a shared continuation waits for all active parallel branches. Never use it to join mutually exclusive alternatives.

result.rule: When the description states that one activity continues while another activity occurs before a later step: Model the concurrent activities as parallel branches, then synchronize them before a later step that depends on both being complete.

When the description says that an activity continues while progress is evaluated and that a later outcome follows only when a stated condition is met.: Model the condition as an intermediate catch event before the outcome, rather than using a parallel split or join that waits for a branch that may no longer be reachable.

When the description presents alternatives for one part of a process while requiring other work to be completed before a later activity: Model the alternatives with an exclusive gateway and the required work as parallel branches; synchronize the required branches before the later activity that depends on their completion.

When the description states that two activities proceed concurrently, or that one activity occurs while another is underway.: Model the concurrent work as separate branches from a parallel gateway, connecting the gateway to each branch’s activity with sequence flows. Join the branches only when subsequent work must await completion of both.
